current_question: Can a relevant record capability be made discoverable through an ordinary product workflow without naming an evaluator, score, record path or editing method?
current_gap: R205 removed the experiment-shaped cues. Four owners coordinated ordinary work extensively but never discovered or changed the mediated native-record surface.

next_condition.mechanism: Read-only handoff-package preview of the selected briefing and a bounded current-activity excerpt.
